headline: Chipotle Stock Is Down 31% in 12 Months – Is It a Buy Ahead of July 29 Q2 Earnings?
summary: Chipotle's own management spent billions buying back stock at prices well above where shares trade today, and Wall Street analysts see a 43% bounce ahead of this week's earnings report. The question is whether a traffic slump will overshadow the bull case or set up the buying opportunity of the year.
